params.body:
Replaces #492, rebased on main after #490.

## Why

On Biedingen > Mijn aangeboden wagens the step button replaced the old hammer icon. The hammer always opened the received bids; the step button only does so while the bidding runs or a winner still has to be assigned. Once a bidding is assigned ("Vrijgeven voor afhaling"), released ("Afgehaald & beoordelen") or delivered, the dealer could no longer see who bid what from the list. Reported by Ilse (dealer team), 2026-09-16: the bids must stay viewable in every phase.

## What

- The more-menu of the row (`export/_row`) and of the phone card (`export/_card`) gets "Bekijk biedingen" (existing key `ui.bidding_view_bids`, present in nl/fr/en/de/es) for every bidding with at least one bid. It opens `export.show.biedingen`, the same page the step button opens in the assign phase.
- A bidding without bids does not get the item.
- The step button is untouched.
- Rule R B1-5.14 added to `docs/bedrijfsregels/21-b1-biedingen.md`; `BiddingFunnelTest::test_the_received_bids_stay_viewable_from_the_menu_in_every_phase_and_only_with_a_bid` pins it (assigned and released biddings expose the bids route in row and card, a bidding without bids does not).

The item is a button that navigates, like its neighbour "Aanpassen": as an anchor it picked up the `.ui-list a` link colour and stood out from the rest of the menu, and the alternative was a line in `refresh.css`.

## Tests

`BiddingFunnelTest`, `ExportListPhoneCardTest`, `BiddingTest`, `BiddingLastDayTest`, `ExportListAccessTest`, `ExportVehicleWindowsTest`, `BiddingBoxLabelTest`, `BiddingDetailDamageOrderTest`, `DemoScreensCommandTest`, `ExportDocumentsFromModelTest`, `SmokeTest` (export routes), `CompiledViewsTest`, `AlpineExpressionTest`, `RulesCoverageTest`, `RulesIdentityTest`, `HandlerWiringTest`, `StylesheetSyntaxTest`: green.

## Screenshots

Row in the "Afgehaald & beoordelen" phase with the menu open, desktop 1440 and phone 390 (demo dataset from `stocklist:demo-screens`, the closed bidding set to released); clicking the item lands on `/exports/{id}/biedingen`.
params.title: Bidding: received bids stay viewable after assignment (rebased, replaces #492)
